name: lighthouse-candidate-intelligence
description: LightHouse Candidate Intelligence Agent — an AG-UI generative-UI app (conversation-ui + dashboard-ui Vite/React frontends + Express agent backend). server/, conversation-ui/, and dashboard-ui/ are independent npm packages — each has its own package-lock.json and node_modules, installed separately. This root package.json has no dependencies of its own (no root node_modules) — it only orchestrates dev/build/typecheck via shell.

scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; npm --prefix server run dev & npm --prefix conversation-ui run dev & npm --prefix dashboard-ui run dev & wait
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix conversation-ui install && npm --prefix dashboard-ui install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix conversation-ui run build && npm --prefix dashboard-ui run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix conversation-ui run typecheck && npm --prefix dashboard-ui run typecheck
